meta.citation: S. M. Kearnes et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2021, 143, 18820; D. M. Lowe, Chemical reactions from US patents (1976-Sep2016), figshare, 2017.
meta.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (Open Reaction Database). The underlying patent reaction data (D. M. Lowe, 2012-2017) is CC0.
meta.limits: Patent procedures. Roles and amounts were extracted by text mining and contain errors. Workup and purification amounts are mostly missing, so the PMI values cover the reaction stage only. Yields are reported yields of many different substrates.
meta.name: Open Reaction Database, US patent reactions (uspto-grants datasets)
